question.worked_solution:
Here, we apply the addition, constant multiple, and power rules:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(3{x}^{4}+\frac{7}{{x}^{4}}-12x) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(3{x}^{4})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(7{x}^{-4})-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(12x) \\  & =3\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{4})+7\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{-4})-12\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x) \\  & =3\cdot 4{x}^{(4-1)}+7\cdot (-4){x}^{(-4-1)}-12\cdot 1 \\  & =12{x}^{3}-28{x}^{-5}-12 \\  & =12{x}^{3}-\frac{28}{{x}^{5}}-12\end{aligned}
$$
